summary: Register says a Lackawanna County bald tower was used around 1917 and removed in 1981. A 1955 federal survey describes a steel tower on Big Pine Hill; whether it is the same tower is unconfirmed.

facts.status_note: Register says removed in 1981. A 2004 survey visit at the Big Pine Hill station found the steel tower dismantled, with a wooden platform in its place. Whether this is the same tower is not confirmed.

events.note: Register says the bald tower was used circa 1917
Coast and Geodetic Survey describes a steel fire-lookout tower about 90 ft high on Big Pine Hill (station LY2745); not confirmed as the register's tower
Register says the tower was removed in 1981
Surveyor visit on 6 August 2004 finds the steel tower dismantled and a wooden platform in its place
Former Fire Lookout Sites Register entry dated September 16, 2008

notes_for_editor: Identity unresolved. The register lists no coordinates ('No coordinates are available' in the cached page), so the record's point 41.63758, -75.71019 has no register source. The NGS station LY2745 is at N 41.235427, W 75.635909 per the SurveyStation page, which does not match the record's point. The register says Pine Hill and the NGS record says Big Pine Hill; the register's 1981 removal and the 2004 destroyed-station visit do not contradict each other if they are the same tower. Unverified leads not used: a 1929 NGS station (LY2747) on Big Pine Hill about 12 miles south of Scranton, and a Big Pine Hill near Bear Lake in Pinchot State Forest; neither page was read. Editor should decide whether the record's coordinates or name should change.
